authorClarification: Three Mills is a distinct landmark at the far edge of Mill Meads, not Abbey Mill near the sewer crossing.

landmarks.name: House Mill
landmarks.evidence: Listed anchor and description: brick and partly weatherboarded north frontage, steep roof and two dormer levels. Dimensions/rotation are distant study estimates.

landmarks.name: Clock Mill
landmarks.evidence: Listed anchor and description: multi-storey brick range, twin conical kiln roofs and staged clock turret. Dimensions and subsidiary offsets estimated; recent replacement cowls omitted.

limits: Listed anchors are not surveyed footprint centres. These are separate landmarks from the existing site-419 distillery range studies. No modern photograph is published or used as a texture.
